title: Core documentation review

checks: An official page, DOI or stable release identifier identifies the dataset version; a Git commit is one option, not a universal requirement.
A documented route explains how to request or obtain the intended release, including restrictions where relevant. No preference is assigned merely for avoiding registration.
Release-specific data terms or an explicit data-license statement can be located. This records terms, not a legal clearance; intended-use compatibility is decided separately under G3.

Describe the available task targets, classes or outcomes and their meaning. The 16-check base profile assumes labeled or measured targets. Unlabeled corpora require a separate profile with its applicable checks fixed in advance.

A label dictionary or target encoding and a basic labeling/measurement procedure are described. Require severity units or ambiguous-case rules only when relevant. Detailed annotator manuals are optional.

At least one concrete review, verification, adjudication or correction practice is documented. Record what was reviewed and by whom or by what process. A generic quality claim or label availability alone is insufficient.

For simple images, a directory tree plus file format and image-to-label mapping can suffice. For tabular/sensor data, require relevant field meanings, units and missing-value codes. A tree alone does not explain target encodings.
Identify the collector or compiler and the collection method or parent datasets. Record derivative relationships where relevant; do not award the same provenance fact again under D3.
Report dataset-specific collection limits, intended uses or known exclusions. Formal bias mitigation experiments are not required for this documentation check.

Report released sample count and its unit, distinguishing images, crops, frames, QA pairs, runs or road sections. Record original capture/group counts separately when available; a raw image count does not prove independence.

Report counts or proportions by the task-relevant class, outcome range or subset. Document negative cases when the task requires them. For unlabeled cohorts, use the prespecified source/subset breakdown.
Identify the collection setting: reported geography/site scope, pavement context and capture setting. Missing location details stay U; general context does not prove match to a user’s target roads.

Describe relevant variation or explicit bounds within that setting, such as sites, conditions, pavement types or acquisition contexts. A documented single-domain boundary can qualify; multiple countries are not required.
Identify the collection platform and relevant sensor or data-generation method at a useful level. A precise camera model is not required for every image task.

For ordinary image tasks, report image dimensions or resolution. For signals or physical measurement tasks, report the required sampling rate, units or physical scale. Freeze the task-specific requirement for the cohort.
Describe preprocessing or transformations affecting interpretation, such as crops, resizing, filtering or normalization. An explicit statement that data are unprocessed can qualify; silence stays U.

gates: Confirm the dataset and assessed release
Assess fit for a declared task
Confirm intended-use rights and verified retrieval
gate_note: G1 identity applies to the inventory. G2 task relevance requires an explicit intended task. G3 requires rights compatibility AND verified retrieval for that task. G4 leakage applies when benchmarking. Gates do not all apply to every descriptive inventory entry, and documentation Y does not pass a reuse gate.

method.Scope: Merge two inventories and apply the v4 Word rubric to documentation evidence. Unit: one identified dataset/release record, not one hosted URL or one independent acquisition corpus.
method.Reconciliation: 248 source records = 177 v3 + 71 AV. Merge 15 AV aliases (14 catalog matches, one probable RSCD mirror). Retain 233 IDs including 56 additions. Preserve all raw source rows and 25 relationship clusters. No payload hash or image-level duplicate scan was performed.
method.Version policy: Use one assessed release per record. DS-072 is pinned to N-RDD v5 using AV evidence. Fresh top-ten evidence supersedes older packets only for the stated release. CrackSeg9k V4 versus original-paper counts and LTPP SDR39 versus portal SDR40 remain explicit review issues.
method.Core factors: A1/A2/A3, L1/L2/L4, D1/D2/D4, C1/C2, R1/R2, M1/M2/M5. The other 24 checks remain visible in MCDM_Rubric as metadata, supporting, task or optional roles. V and E never enter the common documentation score.
method.Cohorts: Labeled-16 uses six domains weighted 1/6. CUPAC (DS-112) and explicitly unlabeled comma2k19 (DS-210), Ford Multi-AV (DS-212) and NATIX Multi-Camera (DS-217) use Unlabeled-13, removing all three L checks cohort-wide and weighting the remaining five domains 1/5. This profile is for unlabeled-use documentation. Define a different task profile if measured pose is the target. Do not compare profile scores directly.
method.State definitions: Y = cited evidence satisfies the criterion. N = affirmative evidence of failure. U = missing, inaccessible, untested or insufficient evidence. X = unresolved conflict. N/A is fixed by the cohort profile, never a favorable per-dataset denominator adjustment.
method.Domain bounds: For m active checks, lower = 5Y/m; upper = 5(Y+U+X)/m; resolved = (Y+N)/m. Dataset lower/upper = 100 times the weighted fractions. Scores are documentation indices, not validated universal quality or suitability ratings.
method.95% rule: Within each deduplicated applicable cohort, compute N/(Y+N+U+X). A nonessential check with strictly more than 95% confirmed N is a candidate for cohort-wide removal. U and X do not become N. No currently scored check crosses the threshold. Any revised profile must be documented and consistently recomputed; do not remove a criterion just because documentation is scarce.
method.Manual workflow: Start at Top10_Review. Open the dataset and evidence links. Enter Y/N/U/X in the dataset row on Manual_Review. Add your name, numeric date, and release confirmation. On MCDM_Checks, enter check-specific human URL, locator and evidence/adjudication in amber columns R:T. Blank human state retains AI evidence. An entered state without complete provenance becomes effective U and stays flagged.
method.Human status: Core review recorded means the applicable check states have complete recorded provenance. It does not mean every uncertainty is resolved or any gate has passed. Review N and X carefully. Do not copy AI answers into human fields without examining the source.
method.Stage gates: G1 identity applies to the inventory. G2 task relevance requires an explicit intended task. G3 requires rights compatibility AND verified retrieval for that task. G4 leakage applies when benchmarking. Gates do not all apply to every descriptive inventory entry, and documentation Y does not pass a reuse gate.
method.Top ten: Purposive review sequence: SDNET2018, CRACK500, RDD2022, PaveBench, CrackSeg9k, UAV-PDD2023, Pothole600, PVS, LTPP and ZOD. Covers classification, segmentation, detection, multimodal tasks, derivative lineage, UAV, stereo, inertial, engineering and AV condition metadata. CrackSeg9k shares parent data with other picks deliberately for overlap review. Never pool these as independent samples.
method.Source confidence: Ten candidates and the CAMBER Video 1 scope check have fresh primary-documentation assessments. CrackBlock also has a fresh D4 check. Other assessments reinterpret the source workbooks evidence snapshots. All are AI provisional; no payload inspection, independent human rating or successful retrieval is claimed. Each core decision has a source, locator, summary and rationale.
method.AI disclosure draft: AI assisted inventory normalization, proposed alias matches, extracted documentation evidence, drafted rubric applications and produced the workbook. Criteria came from the documented v4 protocol and meeting decisions. Human authors must verify identities, evidence, labels, intended-use rights and final inclusion decisions. Record actual system/model, date, prompts, sources, corrections and human reviewers before manuscript submission. No human validation has been fabricated.
method.Label meaning: The Annotation Evidence domain evaluates whether the available task targets are explained and supported. AV object/pose labels do not establish pavement distress targets. Pavement relevance is metadata and G2 must be assessed against the specific study task.
method.Source preservation: Source_v3 preserves the 177 input rows including historical cached scores. Source_AV preserves all 71 AV records with original links. Inputs are unchanged. Platform_Summary, Platform_Unique and AI_Tool_Summary now use the retained inventory. Vehicle_Coverage preserves the dated vehicle-specific findings.
method.Sorting and updates: Use table filters or whole-table sorts. Dataset IDs and dataset-check keys own the joins. Do not sort a single column in isolation. Adding records or changing the core profile requires extending the bounded formulas, evidence ledger and validation ranges. Reweight within a profile only with a documented sensitivity rationale.
method.Method source: Compared_All_Platforms_TH_v4.0.docx, revised core rubric and meeting-resolution sections. Review snapshot: October 11-12, 2026. Current Excel file is version 4.0.

allChecks.Definition: An official page, DOI or stable release identifier identifies the dataset version; a Git commit is one option, not a universal requirement.
A documented route explains how to request or obtain the intended release, including restrictions where relevant. No preference is assigned merely for avoiding registration.
Release-specific data terms or an explicit data-license statement can be located. This records terms, not a legal clearance; intended-use compatibility is decided separately under G3.

When third-party components or identifiable people/vehicles are relevant, record component sources, applicable terms and reported privacy handling. Otherwise record the reason for N/A. Unreported handling remains U.
Before a verified-reuse claim, retrieve and open an authorized sample and record the route, date and result. A documentation review does not require this test.

Describe the available task targets, classes or outcomes and their meaning. The 16-check base profile assumes labeled or measured targets. Unlabeled corpora require a separate profile with its applicable checks fixed in advance.

A label dictionary or target encoding and a basic labeling/measurement procedure are described. Require severity units or ambiguous-case rules only when relevant. Detailed annotator manuals are optional.
Retain available annotator/operator roles, expertise or training as supporting evidence. Named individuals and detailed training histories are not universal core requirements.

At least one concrete review, verification, adjudication or correction practice is documented. Record what was reviewed and by whom or by what process. A generic quality claim or label availability alone is insufficient.
A quantitative agreement, error or reliability result identifies the audit sample and method and meets the tolerance set before scoring.

For simple images, a directory tree plus file format and image-to-label mapping can suffice. For tabular/sensor data, require relevant field meanings, units and missing-value codes. A tree alone does not explain target encodings.
Identify the collector or compiler and the collection method or parent datasets. Record derivative relationships where relevant; do not award the same provenance fact again under D3.
Store version and parent/derivative information with the identity record. A first release is acceptable. This metadata supports A1/D2 and earns no duplicate core point.
Report dataset-specific collection limits, intended uses or known exclusions. Formal bias mitigation experiments are not required for this documentation check.
Attach a URL/file and exact page, section or field to every assessed fact. This is mandatory review provenance, not an additional point for documentation already credited elsewhere.

Report released sample count and its unit, distinguishing images, crops, frames, QA pairs, runs or road sections. Record original capture/group counts separately when available; a raw image count does not prove independence.

Report counts or proportions by the task-relevant class, outcome range or subset. Document negative cases when the task requires them. For unlabeled cohorts, use the prespecified source/subset breakdown.
Counts are reported by relevant capture group, such as road segment, route, trip, site or session.
Independent group counts are reported separately for training and evaluation splits.
A learning curve, precision calculation or comparable quantitative analysis supports enough data for the selected task and preset tolerance.
Identify the collection setting: reported geography/site scope, pavement context and capture setting. Missing location details stay U; general context does not prove match to a user’s target roads.

Describe relevant variation or explicit bounds within that setting, such as sites, conditions, pavement types or acquisition contexts. A documented single-domain boundary can qualify; multiple countries are not required.

The evaluator compares the documented collection population with one prespecified user task and target population. This is a separate suitability judgment; it is not an obligation on the dataset author.
Reference class/group distributions from C2 and stated limitations from D4 without double-counting them. Formal selection-bias analysis or mitigation experiments are optional research evidence.
Testing on a held-out site, route, region, time or sensor reports performance against the generalization tolerance set before scoring.
Identify the collection platform and relevant sensor or data-generation method at a useful level. A precise camera model is not required for every image task.

For ordinary image tasks, report image dimensions or resolution. For signals or physical measurement tasks, report the required sampling rate, units or physical scale. Freeze the task-specific requirement for the cohort.
Spatial or time references identify capture groups and allow the required inputs and targets to be aligned.
Calibration, synchronization or measurement precision is documented for required inputs. Extra sensors alone earn no point.
Describe preprocessing or transformations affecting interpretation, such as crops, resizing, filtering or normalization. An explicit statement that data are unprocessed can qualify; silence stays U.

Pin the release and identify evaluated examples with stable filenames, record IDs or a manifest. Checksums are optional alternatives. A repository tree supports inventory identity, but an actual benchmark needs exact sample membership.
Split membership and a repeatable splitting rule are provided for the selected task.
Splits exclude overlapping parent images, crops, repeated views and relevant capture groups. Check cross-dataset ancestry when needed.
A runnable loader or processing script and a baseline include environment, preprocessing and training settings.
Task-appropriate test metrics include uncertainty or variation across repeats or independent groups.

For an engineering task, define the selected outcome and its relevant method, units or severity categories. PCI, IRI, distress severity and treatment records are alternatives with different meanings, not jointly mandatory features.
Actual engineering measurements are available with traceable survey sources. An intended application alone does not qualify.
Inputs and engineering outcomes are linked by documented spatial units and compatible observation times.
A documented mapping connects released outcomes and road units to the intended agency's condition scheme or decision categories.
Independent validation measures usefulness for the selected management decision, including prediction or decision error and uncertainty. Label agreement alone does not qualify.

interpretation: Provisional documentation bounds, not quality ratings or confidence intervals. Compare within the same declared profile only.
